additional_info.body:
Dear Nicolas,
Thank you for providing us with timestamps.
We have looked into the logs, and identified that the charger was dealing with network problems during the charging sessions.
In the configuration there seems no problem.
Please let us know if you are still facing issues.
Right now the charger looks healthy and stable.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0469755-DC/Si-D/FR- [Y2 / P7 312547889/10] Configuration Issue CRM:03289000078
additional_info.body:
Dear Priscilla,
Thank you for your reply.
I can see that there are communication errors, but they only affect one charging point, while the second is charging.
In the example below, we can see that PDC 2 remained unavailable throughout the entire connector 1’s charging session.
Whether or not this is a communication problem, this situation is not acceptable. We have received reports from our customers and our teams who have noticed this problem.
If you cannot see more details, can you send the case to the regional team ?
////////////////////
Also, you have closed the case ID0469556 saying that the case
has been resolved.
Was there an intervention? Because, as I mentioned in our exchange, the regional team (Antoine BRUA) told me that another intervention was necessary. We no longer see the error of the energy meter because it has been deactivated pending your intervention so that the connector can be used. Can you please reopen the case ?
////////////////////
Thanks in advance.
Best regards,
Nicolas RAYMOND
